subject: QBR runway scan + OKR gate check — account heatmap and action asks
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: markus.klein@redwood.com, aditya.rao@redwood.com, hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: QBR runway scan + OKR gate check — account heatmap and action asks

Team —

I'm sending the preliminary runway scan and the OKR gate checklist ahead of next week's QBR readout. Attached: the heatmap workbook (tabs: forecast vs. commit, risk flags, legal/proc status) and the one-pagers pack for the top 15 accounts. Please do two things by EOD Monday:

1) Open the heatmap and mark a single status per account: GREEN / YELLOW / RED. Use the "reason" column for a 2-3 word rationale (e.g., "PO pending", "Pricing ask", "Legal review").

2) For accounts tied to OKR Objective #2 (Expand mid-market ARR +35%), add the OKR tag in column H and list the dependent tasks (sales enablement, solution design, CS onboarding specs).

Quick notes (account-by-account highlights pulled from field notes):
- BlueCloud Analytics (rd-8931): expansion motion. Demo next Tues; legal asked for SOC2 evidence and retention SLA. Pricing discussion open.
- Acme Retail: pricing counter requested; procurement looped. Risk: procurement timeline could push close to EOM.
- Nebula Media: technical POC complete; final PO expected but finance needs invoice T&Cs clarified.

Where I need leadership eyes specifically: Acme — should we move this to moderated forecast (i.e., 50% vs. 75%) given procurement noise? BlueCloud — legal ask may add a week but expansion ARR opportunity large; recommend keep as commit with a legal hold flag.

I've scheduled a 30-minute pre-QBR sync on Tuesday 10:00am PT to lock forecast numbers. Invite is on calendar (prep folder link in related_links).

Thanks — please keep replies inline so we have a single-threaded decision log.

—Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Director, Sales Strategy & GTM Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachment: QBR_runway_heatmap_20260612.xlsx (spreadsheet)
Attachment: account-onepagers_Q2_2026.pdf (pdf)

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: tessa.morgan@redwood.com, aditya.rao@redwood.com, hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR runway scan + OKR gate check — account heatmap and action asks

Tessa —

Thanks for the synthesis. Quick inputs inline:

- Acme Retail: flagging YELLOW -> RED for forecasting purposes. Procurement has pushed a new SLA template that the customer’s legal wants to redline; until we see the redlines, move to 40% probability. I'll ping Solutions to see if a temporary concessions package helps.

- BlueCloud Analytics: agree keep as COMMIT but add a "legal hold" tag. Alyssa has been responsive but SOC2 artifacts are required — we'll hand them off to Security to speed.

- Nebula Media: move to GREEN; finance clarity should arrive this week (Rajiv said invoice with net30).

Also, for the OKR gate: we should mark which accounts require product/releng support for quantization/throughput guarantees. That will help defend the expansion ask in the OKR review.

Markus
Markus Klein
VP, Sales

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: tessa.morgan@redwood.com, markus.klein@redwood.com, hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR runway scan + OKR gate check — account heatmap and action asks

Adding a couple of operational items:

- OKR mapping: I'll add a second tab in the heatmap that maps each expansion-account to the specific KR it advances (e.g., BlueCloud -> KR2.1: Expand mid-market ARR). That will make the executive slide a one-click pull.

- Mutual action plans (MAPs): for accounts in YELLOW/RED, can someone own a short MAP with milestones (legal, procurement, billing, POC sign-off)? Suggest owners: Acme -> Markus; BlueCloud -> Hannah; Nebula -> Connor (I'll coordinate).

- Forecast ask: let's lock a conservative table for the exec deck (Commit/Best Case/Worst Case) and put the recommended numbers in the shared sheet.

Aditya
Aditya Rao
Head of Revenue Operations

Thanks Tessa — appreciate the clear pack.

A few items from BlueCloud side:
- Confirmed: demo on Tue 6/16 at 11:00am PT (we added an extra slot for our infra folks).
- SOC2 evidence: procurement/legal requested our vendor's SOC2 report and a description of data retention. Can you share the security artifacts in advance? A download link or one-pager would work.
- Pricing: we're close on the numbers; our finance team is waiting for a final invoice with payment terms (Net30 vs Net45).

I'll be on the pre-QBR sync Tuesday and will bring our legal lead if needed.

—Alyssa
